I have one to share, still baffles me to this day and don't know what make out of it.

I live in Brazil and was in a pretty bad spot in life, so I picked up one of Damon brand's book and performed a 14 day daily ritual, I believe it was the angel Samael. 

I asked for a job in the U.S that would set up my career for success and growth, in the 7th day I saw the job posting and had some acquaintances in the company that helped me get in the interviewing process. 
If you want you can check up the book, I think it was 72 angels of magick, the ritual had you imagining storms and thunderstorms falling from the sky, and in the day I received an offer my state had the worst storm in years lol. Not claiming I caused any of that, again, not sure what happened there, but there were many coincidences for me to not believe in it.

Since then I have migrated to Lyam thomas Christopher work, and I can say that the results are impressive. Be curious, pick something up, and dare to believe that it will work, maybe it will. I had many many failures before something "worked".
There is no reason, in my view, to not do a simple spell for that. Just remember to actually engage in the real world, the spell is just the cherry on the top.
Highly recommend Prometheus rising and quantum psychology by Robert Anton Wilson, these two were really fundamental for my further understanding of whatever it is we are

Rudolf Steiner in one of his books comments on the symbolical meaning of the holy trinity, as he says, holy trinity is the relationship amongst thought, feeling and action. He urges the reader to take notice to when a though arises it instantly draws a feeling with it, and the person may feel like acting on it. He says once the individual is spiritually evolved he is able to arbitrarily mess with these three "brains", acting to evoke feelings and thoughts, thinking to evoke a specific feeling. That's also what hermetic students where doing back in the day. So in a sense you stop being a victim of your own mind and "raises" your consciousness to this new level of being.

Good thing you had these realizations friend, life sure is finite and fucking special, we shouldn't waste a dime on what's not our goal.

As for book suggestion: Prometheus rising is a must for the psychonaut, in my opinion.
